Method of Attack: Allows remote code execution (RCE) by exploiting the verify() method with maliciously crafted JWT requests
Performs arbitrary file writes on the target machine due to lack of validation in the 'secretOrPublicKey' parameter
Impacted Systems: Over 22,000 open-source projects using JsonWebToken library
Attack Vector: Exploitation of the 'secretOrPublicKey' parameter in the verify() method
